note: Reviewed findings about how a school awards freshman merit scholarships, each a verbatim sentence from an official page already fetched by the national pipeline (evidence retained in evidence-store). A finding never states an amount or threshold it does not quote, never infers an SAT equivalent, and never presents a competitive award as an expected offer. score_formula no_published_score_formula = the school states it has no fixed or pre-set criteria (different from not_researched and from source_inaccessible). Found with scripts/scan_merit_statements.py; every finding is read in context before it is recorded. Quotes are verbatim; where the page breaks a sentence across lines the quote collapses the whitespace. A finding with applies_to covers only that group or entry term; basis implied_by_sentence marks a value implied rather than stated.

fields.score_formula: no_published_score_formula | (a grid is recorded as awards records instead)

fields.superscore_scope: which tests are combined, as stated
